messages:
morgan: FYI — Clipper (Dedicated) reported p99 spikes last night, CS raised an SLA risk (customer wants ETA). Can infra/runtime/SRE weigh in on owner and short-term mitigation?

sophia: I'm on call today. Initial Scrape shows a KV cache miss burst around 02:13 UTC correlated with many cold-started workers.

raj: Do we have a recent rollout that could've changed routing or autoscale policies? I can check commit history.

elaine: No rollout from infra yesterday. There was a runtime micro-optimization merged Wed — but it was small. I can revert a subset if we need a quick rollback.

morgan: @sophia can you paste the top error/log snippet? CS needs something to share with the customer about cause. :eyes:

sophia: Here are the core lines from the runtime logs at spike: ```ERROR RuntimeServe: kv_lookup timeout 120ms key_prefix=clipper-session, pool=dedicated-pool-7
WARN BatchCoordinator: created 3 extra batches, latency 380ms
INFO Worker: cold start: loading model shard 0 took 1.8s```

morgan: Ok that points to cache miss + cold start. Short term: propose enabling a small warm replica for Clipper (pin one container) and temporarily increase prewarmed slots for the pool.

raj: Warm replica + bump prewarm seems reasonable. DevOps impact? cost bump short-term.

elaine: I can push a hotfix to pin replica and increase autoscale min to 2 for that pool. Needs a small canary to avoid affecting other customers. I can do it in 30m if owners agree.

morgan: Owners: elaine for hotfix, sophia for monitoring & verification, raj for rollout gating and rollback plan. CS: please tell Clipper we'll have a mitigation in ~45 minutes and then a follow-up RCA within 24 hours.

customer-success-bot: Noted — sending customer a brief: "We are applying a temporary resilience config (warm replica + prewarm) to mitigate p99 spikes. ETA 45 minutes, we'll follow up with detailed RCA within 24 hours."

devops-bot: Action created: INFR-7123 (pin warm replica for dedicated-pool-7) assigned to elaine, ETA 45m.

raj: I'll prepare a rollback runbook and watch for any canary noise. If latency increases elsewhere, I'll revert.

elaine: Starting canary now — will post results in 10m.

sophia: I added a short-lived dashboard to track kv_hit_rate, worker_cold_starts, p99 latency for pool-7. Sharing link: https://dashboards.internal/r/clipper-pool7 (internal).

morgan: Thanks team. Post-canary: please add a short note in the incident log (incidents channel) and tag me. We'll decide on a permanent fix (cache warming + smarter prewarm policy) after RCA. :thumbsup:

elaine: Canary looks good so far — p99 down from 820ms to 120ms on sampled traffic. Proceeding to full mitigation rollout.

raj: Rollout done. Monitoring for 30m.

sophia: Confirmed — no further spikes for 20m. I'll start RCA RPM: check model loading path, cache TTLs, and backlog that caused extra batches.

morgan: Great. Assigning follow-ups: RCA doc (elaine + sophia), cost impact estimate (raj), permanent mitigation plan (runtime team). I'll update CS after RCA draft.

customer-success-bot: Customer updated with mitigation completion and next steps. They acknowledged and asked for timeline for permanent fix — we'll reply after RCA.

morgan: Closing thread for active mitigation. Keep posting RCA progress in incidents and tag me for review. Thanks everyone.
